bodies.what_to_report: Private health, life, and property insurance companies.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates consumer complaints against insurance companies, including claim denials and bad faith practices. It also administers an external review program for health insurance denials.

bodies.oversight_body: FSSA Office of Medicaid Policy — HIP 2.0
bodies.what_to_report: Indiana's Medicaid program, including HIP 2.0.
bodies.legal_threshold: Handles complaints and grievances related to HIP 2.0, including POWER Account lockouts, managed care plan issues, and access to care failures. It also oversees the state fair hearing process for Medicaid appeals.

bodies.oversight_body: Indiana Department of Labor — Wage Claims
bodies.what_to_report: Indiana's wage and hour laws.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates wage claims related to the Indiana minimum wage, Wage Payment Act, child labor, and prevailing wage laws. However, its enforcement capacity is limited, and private lawsuits are often more effective.

bodies.what_to_report: Child abuse and neglect.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates reports of child abuse and neglect and provides child welfare services. It operates a 24/7 hotline for reporting.

bodies.what_to_report: Housing discrimination under the Indiana Civil Rights Law.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates housing discrimination complaints based on race, color, religion, sex, disability, national origin, and familial status. The ICRC can order remedies for violations.

bodies.oversight_body: HUD Fair Housing — Chicago Regional Office
bodies.what_to_report: Federal Fair Housing Act violations.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates housing discrimination complaints under the federal Fair Housing Act. It works in conjunction with the ICRC and has a one-year statute of limitations for filing complaints.

bodies.what_to_report: Employment discrimination under the Indiana Civil Rights Law.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates employment discrimination complaints based on race, color, religion, sex, disability, national origin, and age. It has a 180-day statute of limitations and work-shares with the EEOC. Notably, it does not cover sexual orientation or gender identity discrimination.

bodies.what_to_report: Federal employment discrimination laws.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates employment discrimination complaints under federal laws such as Title VII, the ADA, and the ADEA. It has a 300-day statute of limitations and is the sole recourse for LGBTQ+ discrimination claims in Indiana.

bodies.oversight_body: DOL Wage and Hour Division — Indianapolis
bodies.what_to_report: Federal wage and hour laws.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates violations of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), including minimum wage, overtime, and FMLA provisions. It can recover back wages and liquidated damages for employees.

bodies.what_to_report: Law enforcement officer conduct.
bodies.legal_threshold: Handles the decertification of law enforcement officers for serious misconduct, excessive force, or criminal convictions. It is the primary state-level accountability mechanism for law enforcement.

bodies.what_to_report: Constitutional violations by law enforcement agencies.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates patterns or practices of unconstitutional conduct by law enforcement agencies. It can also prosecute individual officers for federal civil rights crimes.

bodies.oversight_body: Indiana Office of Administrative Law Proceedings (OALP)
bodies.what_to_report: State benefit appeals.
bodies.legal_threshold: Conducts fair hearings for appeals of SNAP, HIP 2.0, TANF, and CCDF decisions. It provides an impartial review of agency determinations.

bodies.what_to_report: Unemployment insurance appeals.
bodies.legal_threshold: Handles appeals of UI denials and overpayments. The process includes an appeal to an Administrative Law Judge (ALJ), the DWD Review Board, and then the Indiana Court of Appeals.

bodies.name: Indiana Medical Board
bodies.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state medical board
bodies.what_to_report: Prescribing violations, polypharmacy harm, medication mismanagement, physician misconduct

bodies.name: Indiana Patient Advocacy
bodies.what_to_report: Patient rights violations, family exclusion from care decisions, informed consent issues

bodies.name: Indiana Department of Health
bodies.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state health department
bodies.what_to_report: Healthcare facility complaints, public health violations, licensing concerns

bodies.name: HHS Office for Civil Rights
bodies.what_to_report: HIPAA violations, medical records access denial, privacy breaches, discrimination in healthcare

bodies.name: Indiana Board of Pharmacy
bodies.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state pharmacy board
bodies.what_to_report: Medication dispensing errors, drug interaction failures, pharmacy practice violations

bodies.name: Indiana Protection & Advocacy
bodies.what_to_report: Rights violations during psychiatric holds, restraint/seclusion abuse, denial of legal rights

bodies.name: Indiana Mental Health Authority
bodies.what_to_report: Involuntary commitment violations, patient rights violations, facility conditions, treatment concerns

bodies.name: The Joint Commission
bodies.what_to_report: Hospital accreditation violations, patient safety concerns, restraint/seclusion policy violations
